## 4. Engineering Thinking & Methodology (6-Stage Flow)
1. **Discovery & Scope:** Problem mapping, constraint identification, latency budgeting.
2. **Architecture & Schema:** Relational MySQL/PostgreSQL schema modeling, RBAC mapping, OpenAPI contracts.
3. **Agent Orchestration:** Prompt optimization, zero/few-shot templates, context memory buffers.
4. **Asynchronous Optimization:** FastAPI / AsyncIO queues, Redis caching, sub-100ms response times.
5. **Full-Stack Integration:** Next.js interfaces, WebSocket streams, automated QA with Vitest & Playwright.
6. **Production & Scale:** Docker containers, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD telemetry.
